summary: A brewer considering a refill pilot can price a mobile wash station alongside shipping the empties away.
realLife: In its 2023 amendment to Maine LD 1909, the committee proposed supporting pilots that compared mobile washing, out-of-state shipment, on-site equipment and a fixed Maine facility.
gates: A refill pilot must choose where empty bottles will be washed.
inGame: The bill catalog supplies the bottle-deposit question. needs: a refill pilot must choose where empty bottles will be washed.

turns.what: The brewer seeks a route estimate.
turns.pulledBy: A mobile unit can serve several nearby producers.
turns.writesBack: The pilot budget includes travel and shared use.
